briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate multi-agent benchmark race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on reasoning models amid escalating compute investments. Regulatory pressure mounts on export controls while commercial adoption accelerates across sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. xAI Grok-3 achieved new highs on agentic benchmarks while DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on Chinese-language tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly. Microsoft and Google announced new 200MW data center clusters dedicated to training runs exceeding 10^27 FLOPs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superhuman coding agent trigger an irreversible acceleration in AI self-improvement loops before 2028?
